summary: Horizon Space Acquisition I Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that at an April 20, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, shareholders approved extending the deadline to complete a business combination to June 12, 2027, by amending the trust agreement and charter. The blank-check company (Cayman Islands-domiciled, OTC-traded) entered a Trust Amendment with Continental Stock Transfer to postpone trust liquidation. No deal terms are disclosed; this is a routine SPAC extension vote to avoid liquidation. Watch for the company to identify a target or risk delisting if no combination closes by the new date.
